name: wwjd
description: What Would Johannes Do: opinionated UI/UX rules and workflow. Three skills (wwjd:ux for structure, behaviour and copy; wwjd:look for the look; wwjd:motion for motion), a cold critic agent on request, a prompt hook that routes UI work, and an auto-lint hook after UI edits.

creativity.title: Look: plain ↔ expressive
creativity.description: 1 Plain … 3 Balanced (default) … 5 Expressive. /wwjd-dials shows every stop.

budget.title: Content: lean ↔ rich
budget.description: 1 Minimal … 3 Balanced (default) … 5 Rich. /wwjd-dials shows every stop.

density.title: Spacing: roomy ↔ compact
density.description: 1 Roomy … 3 By product (default) … 5 Compact. /wwjd-dials shows every stop.

motion.title: Motion: still ↔ lively
motion.description: 1 Still … 3 By product (default) … 5 Lively. /wwjd-dials shows every stop.

voice.title: Copy: terse ↔ warm
voice.description: 1 Terse … 3 Plain (default) … 5 Warm. /wwjd-dials shows every stop.

rigor.title: Checking: quick ↔ thorough
rigor.description: 1 Quick … 3 Standard (default) … 5 Thorough. /wwjd-dials shows every stop.

grade.title: Grading
grade.description: Written (default): A grade sheet for each over-budget surface before it is built. · In your head: Over-budget surfaces graded without a sheet; the handover lists what moved.
